repair_rationale: Candidate 1 separated all 10 development families 10/10, but character unigram, word-length-only, and within-word-shuffled nuisance arms also separated 10/10. The German transport used ReF Modernisierter Lesetext. Candidate 2 minimally repairs this known representation confound by replacing only the German text representation with ReF's historical Wort layer. No scoring-rule tuning is allowed.

fixed_from_candidate1.yiddish_representation: PPCHY Romanisation reduced by the frozen v02/v03 a-z atomizer
fixed_from_candidate1.budget_rule: deterministic work-family round-robin with residual redistribution
fixed_from_candidate1.segment_selection: SHA256 public-seed deterministic contiguous 512-word segment; same public seed as candidate 1
fixed_from_candidate1.primary_evaluator: character trigram additive-smoothed held-out bits per alphabetic source atom
fixed_from_candidate1.preflight_call: positive (German BPA - Yiddish BPA) calls Yiddish
nuisance_arms: within-word deterministic letter shuffle scored by trigram models
fixed_from_candidate1.null: exact enumeration of all 252 balanced 5-Yiddish/5-German work-family label assignments

only_change_from_candidate1.german_representation: ReF historical Wort layer from a reproducibly acquired official/official-derived ReF corpus payload, reduced to a-z after source extraction

pre_scoring_gates: The extracted ReF corpus must expose a layer explicitly identified as Wort or an equivalent original/diplomatic token layer.
F014/F015/F016/F018/F034/F037/F148 must be identified from document metadata, not guessed by position.
At least 10000 build words must be available under the fixed work-balanced rule per language and at least 512 words in every development family.
Exact/near passage overlap audit between German BUILD and DEVELOPMENT must show zero exact 8-word overlaps; any non-zero 5-word overlaps are reported.
The source payload and extraction code hashes are committed before scores are interpreted.

development_evaluator_feasible_requires: primary effect over exact balanced-label null >= 2 null SD
primary must materially outperform each shallow nuisance arm: at least one development-family error more than the primary for unigram, length-only, and within-word-shuffle arms
primary signs must not be explained by a single corpus/editor/source-family artifact visible in metadata

qualification_guardrail: Even a candidate-2 development pass cannot issue L. Historical Hebrew, fresh Yiddish confirmation, frozen candidate-specific acceptance/margin/abstention calibration, and joint recovery+language confirmation remain required.
